hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: Alpha Co (W2) reported three applied refunds (order 170: 17127 cents, order 172: 7535 cents, order 175: 2957 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty refunds table. Payouts computed from net_balance may be overstated, so no payouts have been recorded. Needs human review of whether the refunds were applied to the shared ledger before paying.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to check the refunds table against the refunds Alpha reported. Starting with list_refunds.

The refunds table is empty, but Alpha reported three refunds (orders 170, 172, 175). The mismatch means the ledger may not reflect the refunds, so paying now could overpay customers. Recording a payout cannot be undone, so I'm stopping the batch for review.
